subject: English
title: 英文第29題｜阿米希人閱讀的最佳標題
question:
What is the best title for the reading?
(A) The History of the Amish
(B) The Amish and Their Different Way of Living
(C) Why Do the Amish Live a Simple Life?
(D) How Do the Amish Grow Their Healthy Food?
answer: (B) The Amish and Their Different Way of Living
explanation:
一、標題要涵蓋全文
文章雖先提移居與人口，主體介紹阿米希人的交通、媒體使用、農耕與簡單生活，最後也回到healthy, happy, and simple way of life，故B「阿米希人及其不同的生活方式」最完整。

二、排除只涵蓋局部的標題
A只強調歷史，不能涵蓋大量當代生活敘述；C問為何過簡單生活，但文章以描述生活為主，沒有完整解釋形成原因；D只談種食物，範圍太窄。

三、作答方法
先把各段縮成主題：背景與人口、交通與媒體、農耕、生活總結，再找能包住所有重點的標題。原文為教材概括，不據此斷言所有阿米希社群對科技的規範完全相同。

passage:
Do you know the Amish, a group of people living mostly in the USA and Canada?
The Amish started to live in the USA a long time ago. They first arrived about three hundred years ago, found land to farm, and their way of living now is about the same as before.

In 1920, there were about 5,000 Amish people in the USA, in 1984, about 84,000, and in 2020, about 346,600. Pennsylvania has the most Amish population, 81,500, and Ohio, the second most, 78,280.

The Amish live a simple life, and it is quite different from ours. For example, they do not own motorcycles or cars. They go around by horse. Almost all of them do not have a television, a radio, or a computer in their house. They do not use a cellphone or the Internet. Food is an important part of their life. They grow their own food on the farm mostly by hand. Though it takes a lot more time, most of them refuse to use modern machines. They want to live their life as simple as possible.

No one knows if the Amish are going to change their lifestyle in the future, but one thing is for sure. They enjoy their healthy, happy, and simple way of life.

原卷詞註：population 人口；lifestyle 生活方式。
